normative_extracts.quote: The accessible name is computed by traversing aria-labelledby, aria-label, native host language labeling elements, and descendant text content in priority order.
Elements with aria-hidden='true' or CSS display: none are not exposed in the accessibility tree.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Role queries compute WAI-ARIA roles and AccName 1.2 strings while pruning hidden or inert subtrees, verifying both interactive semantics and user-visible labeling.

production_failures.symptom: Keyboard and screen-reader users cannot submit checkout form despite green E2E tests
production_failures.root_cause: Tests clicked [data-testid='checkout-btn'] on a <div onClick> with no role='button', tabindex, or Enter-key handler.
production_failures.mitigation: Replace data-testid with getByRole('button', { name: 'Checkout' }) so non-semantic divs fail in CI.

production_failures.symptom: Component test suite slows to 45 seconds on a large data-grid test
production_failures.root_cause: Repeated getByRole('cell') queries in JSDOM re-traverse thousands of DOM nodes synchronously for AccName computation.
production_failures.mitigation: Virtualize rows, scope queries with within(row), or run large-DOM tests in a real browser.
